H-006.text: Combining the NOPAT estimates from c1 with year-end TICAP from c2, ROTIC can only be computed where consecutive year-end TICAP values are available one year apart: FY2023 (average of FY2022 and FY2023 TICAP). NOPAT over an average TICAP of €22,238.5 million gives a ROTIC of 7.5% for FY2023. For FY2025 and FY2026, the prior-year TICAP (FY2024) is not computable from the data, so the year-end TICAP stands in for the average: this gives 10.6% for FY2025 and 9.2% for FY2026. Averaging these three fiscal years (FY2023, FY2025, FY2026) gives a mean ROTIC of 9.1%. No TICAP is computable for FY2019-FY2021 or FY2024, so only three of the nine fiscal years from FY2018 to FY2026 could be used, well short of the ten-year window the criterion asks for.
